## Giant Demon Gnoll (CR 3)

*Hunched and feral, this furred, hyena-headed humanoid stands much taller than the average human. Its eyes flash evilly in the reflected light of your lantern.*  


**XP** 800  
CE Large humanoid ( augmented, gnoll)  
**Init** -1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 8, flat-footed 19 (-1 Dex, +7 armor, +4 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 33 (3d8+9)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +0, **Will** +1  
**Resist** cold 5, fire 5; **SR** 8  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft. (30 ft. unarmored)  
**Melee** 2 claws +5 (1d4+4) and bite +4 (1d6+4), or  
**Melee** masterwork battle axe +5 (2d6+6/x3), or  
**Ranged** javelin -1 (1d8+4, range increment 30 ft.)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** smite good (+1 attack rolls, +3 damage)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 19, **Dex** 8, **Con** 17, **Int** 8, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Intimidating Prowess, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +10, Perception +4; **Armor Check Penalty** -7  
**Language** Abyssal, Gnoll  


**Special Abilities**


**Smite Good (Su)** 1/day as a swift action; adds Cha bonus to attack rolls and damage bonus equal to HD against good foes; smite persists until target is dead or the giant demon gnoll rests.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** warm plains or desert  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or war party (2-4 giant demon gnolls, 3-9 gnolls, and 2-4 hyenas)  
**Treasure** NPC gear (*potion of* *entropic shield*, masterwork battle axe, two javelins, splint mail, plus approximately 150 gp of other gear)
